terms.title: Terms & Policy
terms.content:
Welcome to our community.

1. Community Guidelines:
All content shared is strictly for community members. Distribution, re-uploading, or piracy is strictly prohibited.

2. Privacy:
We respect your privacy. No personal identifiable data beyond your basic Telegram interaction info is stored.

3. Compliance:
By joining and accessing our channels, you confirm you meet the age and legal requirements of your local jurisdiction.

For queries or concerns, contact our bot administrator.

🤖 *avnifanbbot Help & Information*

Welcome to @avnifanbbot!
This bot delivers special video messages with an automatic self-destruction timer.

📌 *Available Commands:*
• /start - Receive a video message with auto-delete timer
• /video - Fetch the next video message
• /list - View all active drops
• /help - Show this information

⏱ *Default Timer:* {timer_text}
Messages will be permanently deleted once the timer runs out.
